agricultura.

áreas de ladera hacia los límites con caños y montaña.
summaryEn: Cattle ranch for immediate sale at a bargain price.
detailsEn:
General Information
• Property Name: Finca San Rafael | Locality (Vereda): San Antonio
• Location: Border between Puerto Concordia (western side) and Mapiripán, Meta Department.
• Total Area: 349.4 hectares (per certified topographic survey) / 338 hectares (per current public deeds).
• Primary Use: Agricultural and multipurpose (livestock, agriculture, and agritourism).
Area Distribution and Topography
• Savanna / Production Area: 250 hectares suitable for livestock and agriculture.
• Natural Reserve (Forest/Highland): 50 hectares of native forest, a refuge for Orinoquía flora and fauna.
• Topography: Flat savanna with low-lying areas, lagoons, firm wetlands, and sloping terrain near the boundaries with streams and forest areas.
